title: How a 10% Rule Beats Traditional Budgets

scenes.text: What if 10% of every paycheck could replace your budget?
Allocate the 10% to a separate high‑yield account before any spending.
scenes.label: SEPARATE HIGH‑YIELD ACCOUNT
scenes.query: high yield savings account for 10 percent rule
scenes.query2: separate savings account pay yourself first

scenes.text: Track only the remaining 90% – you’ll notice natural spending cuts.
scenes.label: TRACK REMAINING 90%

scenes.text: Over time the saved 10% compounds, often outpacing detailed line‑item budgets.
scenes.label: COMPOUND OUTPERFORMS BUDGET
scenes.query: compound interest effect of 10 percent savings

scenes.text: Follow for the money mindset they don't teach you.

description: Skip the tedious spreadsheet. The 10% rule simplifies saving, cuts stress, and often yields better results than traditional budgeting.
